description: Lookup normalization runs three stages in a fixed order — width conversion, lookup-variant fold, combining-character normalization — and this case pins the composed result for each input. The fold expands the iteration marks ゝ/ゞ/ヽ/ヾ (a voiced mark voices the repeat when the preceding kana has a voiced form, otherwise it is a plain repeat; a mark whose preceding character is not kana of its script is left alone), expands Roman numerals, folds ℃ and obsolete kana, folds the Chinese-only forms and the measured Unihan variant pairs onto the dictionary form (never backwards, and never for pairs the direction guard rejects), while width conversion widens halfwidth/fullwidth forms and folds vertical presentation forms back to their horizontal forms. Decomposed combining sequences compose where the table covers them and stay decomposed otherwise: this is not a general NFC pass.

cases.note: empty input stays empty

cases.input: 日本語のテキストです。
cases.expect: 日本語のテキストです。
